# SD18 deterministic Human Paladin level 15 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 level-14 fixture
# (tests/sd18_paladin_level14_widening.rs) to level 15 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic Longsword / Chain
# Shirt / no-shield / Power Attack posture, and the level-3..level-14
# fixture's mercy selections unchanged (choice:paladin_mercy ->
# mercy:shaken, choice:paladin_mercy_4 -> mercy:blinded), adding a FIFTH
# mercy selection (choice:paladin_mercy_5 -> mercy:deafened) for the new
# 15th-level repeat mercy grant.
#
# The PF1 CRB Paladin class table's level-15 "Special" column reads
# "Mercy" ONLY (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the
# Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both agreeing byte-for-byte) --
# 15th IS a repeat-Mercy-grant level (the 3rd/6th/9th/12th/15th
# cadence), grounded here as a FIFTH numbered mercy choice slot mirroring
# the proven slot-2/3/4 idiom exactly: an open-ended +0 recognition of
# whichever raw mercy string is chosen, with the verified 15th-level CRB
# mercy-list state cited (no NEW tier of named mercy conditions is added
# at 15th level -- both primary sources agree the CRB mercy list's named
# tiers stop growing after 12th level, so the paladin simply selects a
# fifth mercy from the already-existing 3rd/6th/9th/12th-tier pool). No
# mercy's effect on lay on hands is computed.
#
# The base spells-per-day table's level-15 row is "3/2/2/1" (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com
# mirror): the 1st/2nd/4th-level columns stay 3/2/1 unchanged, and the
# 3rd-level column genuinely rises from 1 to 2.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy
# EFFECT resolution, no channel positive energy healing/damage-resolution
# execution, no Divine Bond (weapon bond / mount bond) selection or
# execution, no Aura of Justice's own smite-sharing resolution, no Aura
# of Faith's own good-alignment-weapon-treatment resolution, and no
# level-16+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level15
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:15
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
choice=choice:paladin_mercy_4:mercy:blinded
choice=choice:paladin_mercy_5:mercy:deafened
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
